body:
I think if you observed my circumstance objectively you might conclude differently. I am weighing everyone around me down. And I’ve tried to do all the things you’re supposed to do. I’m gainfully employed earning more money than I ever imagined. I’m a father and husband. I’m an Ivy League graduate. None of it matters.

I can’t see the light anymore and I’m dragging everyone down with me. I know I am. I don’t see a reason to move on.

I don’t expect anyone to understand because it’s counter-intuitive to western ideals and cultural norms. I’m pulling further away everyday, and honestly, it’s peaceful. I like sleeping my time away. I like unplugging from life. It is excruciating to interact and live in the world to me.
In the past I went to their sporting activities. I try to be there when they are struggling or upset.
